_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). Long Beach City 37213 (CSU GE-Breadth certificate) was read from the LBCC-GE (Plan A) page, the local associate degree pattern, and holds as not the program's own. This read prints the general education plans index with its links, so a session can see whether the 2026-2027 catalog prints a CSU GE-Breadth pattern or certificate page at all, and its address. One load. No model call, nothing written.
